name: cognito-idp
description: With the Amazon Cognito user pools API, you can configure user pools and authenticate users.

subcommands.name: add-custom-attributes
subcommands.description: Adds additional user attributes to the user pool schema.

subcommands.name: add-user-pool-client-secret
subcommands.description: Creates a new client secret for an existing confidential user pool app client.

subcommands.name: admin-add-user-to-group
subcommands.description: Adds a user to a group.

subcommands.name: admin-confirm-sign-up
subcommands.description: Confirms user sign-up as an administrator.

subcommands.name: admin-create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a new user in the specified user pool.

subcommands.name: admin-delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes a user profile in your user pool.

subcommands.name: admin-delete-user-attributes
subcommands.description: Deletes attribute values from a user.

subcommands.name: admin-disable-provider-for-user
subcommands.description: Prevents the user from signing in with the specified external (SAML or social) identity provider (IdP).

subcommands.name: admin-disable-user
subcommands.description: Deactivates a user profile and revokes all access tokens for the user.

subcommands.name: admin-enable-user
subcommands.description: Activates sign-in for a user profile that previously had sign-in access disabled.

subcommands.name: admin-forget-device
subcommands.description: Forgets, or deletes, a remembered device from a user's profile.

subcommands.name: admin-get-device
subcommands.description: Given the device key, returns details for a user's device.

subcommands.name: admin-get-user
subcommands.description: Given a username, returns details about a user profile in a user pool.

subcommands.name: admin-get-user-auth-factors
subcommands.description: Lists the authentication options for a user in a user pool.

subcommands.name: admin-initiate-auth
subcommands.description: Starts sign-in for applications with a server-side component, for example a traditional web application.

subcommands.name: admin-link-provider-for-user
subcommands.description: Links an existing user account in a user pool, or DestinationUser, to an identity from an external IdP, or SourceUser, based on a specified attribute name and value from the external IdP.

subcommands.name: admin-list-devices
subcommands.description: Lists a user's registered devices.

subcommands.name: admin-list-groups-for-user
subcommands.description: Lists the groups that a user belongs to.

subcommands.name: admin-list-user-auth-events
subcommands.description: Requests a history of user activity and any risks detected as part of Amazon Cognito threat protection.

subcommands.name: admin-remove-user-from-group
subcommands.description: Given a username and a group name, removes them from the group.

subcommands.name: admin-reset-user-password
subcommands.description: Begins the password reset process.

subcommands.name: admin-respond-to-auth-challenge
subcommands.description: Some API operations in a user pool generate a challenge, like a prompt for an MFA code, for device authentication that bypasses MFA, or for a custom authentication challenge.

subcommands.name: admin-set-user-mfa-preference
subcommands.description: Sets the user's multi-factor authentication (MFA) preference, including which MFA options are activated, and if any are preferred.

subcommands.name: admin-set-user-password
subcommands.description: Sets the specified user's password in a user pool.

subcommands.name: admin-set-user-settings
subcommands.description: This action is no longer supported.

subcommands.name: admin-update-auth-event-feedback
subcommands.description: Provides the feedback for an authentication event generated by threat protection features.

subcommands.name: admin-update-device-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a user's device so that it is marked as remembered or not remembered for the purpose of device authentication.

subcommands.name: admin-update-user-attributes
subcommands.description: Updates the specified user's attributes.

subcommands.name: admin-user-global-sign-out
subcommands.description: Invalidates the identity, access, and refresh tokens that Amazon Cognito issued to a user.

subcommands.name: associate-software-token
subcommands.description: Begins setup of time-based one-time password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) for a user, with a unique private key that Amazon Cognito generates and returns in the API response.

subcommands.name: change-password
subcommands.description: Changes the password for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: complete-web-authn-registration
subcommands.description: Completes registration of a passkey authenticator for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: confirm-device
subcommands.description: Confirms a device that a user wants to remember.

subcommands.name: confirm-forgot-password
subcommands.description: This public API operation accepts a confirmation code that Amazon Cognito sent to a user and accepts a new password for that user.

subcommands.name: confirm-sign-up
subcommands.description: Confirms the account of a new user.

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new group in the specified user pool.

subcommands.name: create-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Adds a configuration and trust relationship between a third-party identity provider (IdP) and a user pool.

subcommands.name: create-managed-login-branding
subcommands.description: Creates a new set of branding settings for a user pool style and associates it with an app client.

subcommands.name: create-resource-server
subcommands.description: Creates a new OAuth2.0 resource server and defines custom scopes within it.

subcommands.name: create-terms
subcommands.description: Creates terms documents for the requested app client.

subcommands.name: create-user-import-job
subcommands.description: Creates a user import job.

subcommands.name: create-user-pool
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Cognito user pool.

subcommands.name: create-user-pool-client
subcommands.description: Creates an app client in a user pool.

subcommands.name: create-user-pool-domain
subcommands.description: A user pool domain hosts managed login, an authorization server and web server for authentication in your application.

subcommands.name: create-user-pool-replica
subcommands.description: Creates a replica of an existing user pool in a specified Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a group from the specified user pool.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Deletes a user pool identity provider (IdP).

subcommands.name: delete-managed-login-branding
subcommands.description: Deletes a managed login branding style.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-server
subcommands.description: Deletes a resource server.

subcommands.name: delete-terms
subcommands.description: Deletes the terms documents with the requested ID from your app client.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes the profile of the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: delete-user-attributes
subcommands.description: Deletes attributes from the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: delete-user-pool
subcommands.description: Deletes a user pool.

subcommands.name: delete-user-pool-client
subcommands.description: Deletes a user pool app client.

subcommands.name: delete-user-pool-client-secret
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific client secret from a user pool app client.

subcommands.name: delete-user-pool-domain
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID and domain identifier, deletes a user pool domain.

subcommands.name: delete-user-pool-replica
subcommands.description: Deletes a secondary replica user pool.

subcommands.name: delete-web-authn-credential
subcommands.description: Deletes a registered passkey, or WebAuthn, authenticator for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: describe-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID and identity provider (IdP) name, returns details about the IdP.

subcommands.name: describe-managed-login-branding
subcommands.description: Given the ID of a managed login branding style, returns detailed information about the style.

subcommands.name: describe-managed-login-branding-by-client
subcommands.description: Given the ID of a user pool app client, returns detailed information about the style assigned to the app client.

subcommands.name: describe-resource-server
subcommands.description: Describes a resource server.

subcommands.name: describe-risk-configuration
subcommands.description: Given an app client or user pool ID where threat protection is configured, describes the risk configuration.

subcommands.name: describe-terms
subcommands.description: Returns details for the requested terms documents ID.

subcommands.name: describe-user-import-job
subcommands.description: Describes a user import job.

subcommands.name: describe-user-pool
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns configuration information.

subcommands.name: describe-user-pool-client
subcommands.description: Given an app client ID, returns configuration information.

subcommands.name: describe-user-pool-domain
subcommands.description: Given a user pool domain name, returns information about the domain configuration.

subcommands.name: forget-device
subcommands.description: Given a device key, deletes a remembered device as the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: forgot-password
subcommands.description: Sends a password-reset confirmation code to the email address or phone number of the requested username.

subcommands.name: get-csv-header
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, generates a comma-separated value (CSV) list populated with available user attributes in the user pool.

subcommands.name: get-device
subcommands.description: Given a device key, returns information about a remembered device for the current user.

subcommands.name: get-group
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID and a group name, returns information about the user group.

subcommands.name: get-identity-provider-by-identifier
subcommands.description: Given the identifier of an identity provider (IdP), for example examplecorp, returns information about the user pool configuration for that IdP.

subcommands.name: get-log-delivery-configuration
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns the logging configuration.

subcommands.name: get-provisioned-limit
subcommands.description: Returns the current provisioned limit for a specific API category.

subcommands.name: get-signing-certificate
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns the signing certificate for SAML 2.0 federation.

subcommands.name: get-tokens-from-refresh-token
subcommands.description: Given a refresh token, issues new ID, access, and optionally refresh tokens for the user who owns the submitted token.

subcommands.name: get-ui-customization
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID or app client, returns information about classic hosted UI branding that you applied, if any.

subcommands.name: get-user
subcommands.description: Gets user attributes and and MFA settings for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: get-user-attribute-verification-code
subcommands.description: Given an attribute name, sends a user attribute verification code for the specified attribute name to the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: get-user-auth-factors
subcommands.description: Lists the authentication options for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: get-user-pool-mfa-config
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns configuration for sign-in with WebAuthn authenticators and for multi-factor authentication (MFA).

subcommands.name: global-sign-out
subcommands.description: Invalidates the identity, access, and refresh tokens that Amazon Cognito issued to a user.

subcommands.name: initiate-auth
subcommands.description: Declares an authentication flow and initiates sign-in for a user in the Amazon Cognito user directory.

subcommands.name: list-devices
subcommands.description: Lists the devices that Amazon Cognito has registered to the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: list-groups
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns user pool groups and their details.

subcommands.name: list-identity-providers
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns information about configured identity providers (IdPs).

subcommands.name: list-resource-servers
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns all resource servers and their details.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are assigned to an Amazon Cognito user pool.

subcommands.name: list-terms
subcommands.description: Returns details about all terms documents for the requested user pool.

subcommands.name: list-user-import-jobs
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns user import jobs and their details.

subcommands.name: list-user-pool-client-secrets
subcommands.description: Lists all client secrets associated with a user pool app client.

subcommands.name: list-user-pool-clients
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, lists app clients.

subcommands.name: list-user-pool-replicas
subcommands.description: Lists all replicas for a user pool, including both primary and secondary replicas.

subcommands.name: list-user-pools
subcommands.description: Lists user pools and their details in the current Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID, returns a list of users and their basic details in a user pool.

subcommands.name: list-users-in-group
subcommands.description: Given a user pool ID and a group name, returns a list of users in the group.

subcommands.name: list-web-authn-credentials
subcommands.description: Generates a list of the currently signed-in user's registered passkey, or WebAuthn, credentials.

subcommands.name: resend-confirmation-code
subcommands.description: Resends the code that confirms a new account for a user who has signed up in your user pool.

subcommands.name: respond-to-auth-challenge
subcommands.description: Some API operations in a user pool generate a challenge, like a prompt for an MFA code, for device authentication that bypasses MFA, or for a custom authentication challenge.

subcommands.name: revoke-token
subcommands.description: Revokes all of the access tokens generated by, and at the same time as, the specified refresh token.

subcommands.name: set-log-delivery-configuration
subcommands.description: Sets up or modifies the logging configuration of a user pool.

subcommands.name: set-risk-configuration
subcommands.description: Configures threat protection for a user pool or app client.

subcommands.name: set-ui-customization
subcommands.description: Configures UI branding settings for domains with the hosted UI (classic) branding version.

subcommands.name: set-user-mfa-preference
subcommands.description: Set the user's multi-factor authentication (MFA) method preference, including which MFA factors are activated and if any are preferred.

subcommands.name: set-user-pool-mfa-config
subcommands.description: Sets user pool multi-factor authentication (MFA) and passkey configuration.

subcommands.name: set-user-settings
subcommands.description: This action is no longer supported.

subcommands.name: sign-up
subcommands.description: Registers a user with an app client and requests a user name, password, and user attributes in the user pool.

subcommands.name: start-user-import-job
subcommands.description: Instructs your user pool to start importing users from a CSV file that contains their usernames and attributes.

subcommands.name: start-web-authn-registration
subcommands.description: Requests credential creation options from your user pool for the currently signed-in user.

subcommands.name: stop-user-import-job
subcommands.description: Instructs your user pool to stop a running job that's importing users from a CSV file that contains their usernames and attributes.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns a set of tags to an Amazon Cognito user pool.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Given tag IDs that you previously assigned to a user pool, removes them.

subcommands.name: update-auth-event-feedback
subcommands.description: Provides the feedback for an authentication event generated by threat protection features.

subcommands.name: update-device-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a the currently signed-in user's device so that it is marked as remembered or not remembered for the purpose of device authentication.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Given the name of a user pool group, updates any of the properties for precedence, IAM role, or description.

subcommands.name: update-identity-provider
subcommands.description: Modifies the configuration and trust relationship between a third-party identity provider (IdP) and a user pool.

subcommands.name: update-managed-login-branding
subcommands.description: Configures the branding settings for a user pool style.

subcommands.name: update-provisioned-limit
subcommands.description: Sets the provisioned limit for a specific API category.

subcommands.name: update-resource-server
subcommands.description: Updates the name and scopes of a resource server.

subcommands.name: update-terms
subcommands.description: Modifies existing terms documents for the requested app client.

subcommands.name: update-user-attributes
subcommands.description: Updates the currently signed-in user's attributes.

subcommands.name: update-user-pool
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of a user pool.

subcommands.name: update-user-pool-client
subcommands.description: Given a user pool app client ID, updates the configuration.

subcommands.name: update-user-pool-domain
subcommands.description: A user pool domain hosts managed login, an authorization server and web server for authentication in your application.

subcommands.name: update-user-pool-replica
subcommands.description: Updates replica-specific settings for a user pool replica.

subcommands.name: verify-software-token
subcommands.description: Registers the current user's time-based one-time password (TOTP) authenticator with a code generated in their authenticator app from a private key that's supplied by your user pool.

subcommands.name: verify-user-attribute
subcommands.description: Submits a verification code for a signed-in user who has added or changed a value of an auto-verified attribute.
